purpose: Define one shared movement-type presentation contract for Soldier records and Hero jobs without reopening the frozen Soldier or Hero semantic pipelines. Movement type is a source value; movement-point distance is independent and must never be used to infer the type.

hero.scopeRule: Hero movement type is job-scoped. Do not assign one global movement type to a Hero when that Hero has multiple jobs.

runtimeConsumption.soldier: Resolve the canonical Soldier ID in shared-movement-type-index.v1.json#soldiersById and then resolve its moveType against definitions.
runtimeConsumption.hero: Resolve the currently displayed Hero job's jobId in shared-movement-type-index.v1.json#heroJobsById and then resolve its moveType against definitions.
runtimeConsumption.iconRule: Use definition.iconFileName as the source asset identifier. Actual extracted PNG delivery/web path is a separate frontend/asset integration step and does not reopen movement semantics.

hardValidationRules: Exactly five movement definitions with unique IDs 1..5 must exist.
Every canonical Soldier ID must resolve to exactly one ConfigDataSoldierInfo record.
Every Hero jobId referenced by the canonical Hero job-link output must resolve to exactly one ConfigDataJobInfo record.
Every resolved Soldier and Hero Job MoveType must be one of the five defined IDs.
MoveType and BF_MovePoint are independent fields. Never infer MoveType from movement distance or vice versa.
Hero movement type remains job-scoped and must not be collapsed to a single Hero-level value.
Production Hero or Soldier page code must not read ConfigData directly when the generated shared index is available.

fieldArmyEvidence.note: Soldier 1037 (마충 거대 수호자 / 魔虫巨卫) is cross-checked against the game UI as 야전 이동. Soldier 1033 is an additional source-data witness that MoveType 5 is not a one-record anomaly.

freezeBoundary.reason: Soldier Stage 5 already preserves raw/normalized moveType for later UI mapping, while Hero movement presentation can be joined by existing canonical jobId. This contract adds a shared presentation/index layer only.
